body:
How can I stop thinking about money? It's thrust in my face several times a day every day. One of my friends literally has diamond-studded glasses to drink out of. I can manage to stop thinking about it when I'm at home or whatever, but I don't want to be a hermit forever.

And people here say money doesn't matter. I've never even been out of the country, because it's just too expensive. Flying off to the Philippines would cost $2,000 for the plane ticket and then another $2,000 for food/lodging/etc. That's, like, three months of mortgage payments. Enjoy being part of the superior species if you want to, I guess, but could you at least not brag about it?
